name: Terre Alfieri

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A Piedmont appellation covering San Damiano, San Martino Alfieri and five other communes in Asti province, plus parts of Govone, Priocca, Magliano Alfieri and Castellinaldo in Cuneo province.
